
::: {#def-boundedness .theorem}
## Boundedness

The assumption that a component function $g_{ti}$ can only take on values from a finite set. i.e. $g_{ti}$ is bounded if there exists a finite set $\mathcal{D}$ and a constant $c$ such that for $\mathbf{X} \in \{0,1\}^n$

$$
g_{ti}(\mathbf{X}) \in \mathcal{D} \quad \text{ for }|\mathcal{D}|< c \in \mathbb{Z}.
$$

An exposure mapping is bounded if it is [separable](#def-separability) and all its component functions are bounded. 
:::
